excerpt: StoreClaw connects AI agents to Shopify, Amazon and other stores to suggest and, with approval, make changes. Free plan; Pro from $19.90/month.
content:
StoreClaw is an AI assistant for online sellers. You connect your stores and channels (the site shows Shopify, Amazon, WooCommerce, eBay, Wix, TikTok and social accounts) and then ask it, in chat, how the business is doing. Its agents run skills for product research, listing writing, SEO and visibility in AI search, ad audits, sales and stock analytics, store design and social content. It also proposes plans on its own, such as rewriting weak product titles, and carries them out only after you approve them.

Connections use OAuth and are read-only by default; write access is granted only when you set up an action. The privacy policy says conversation data, files and task instructions are not used to train AI models. There is a forever-free plan with daily credits, and paid plans from $19.90 a month; new accounts get 300 credits.

StoreClaw is made by StoreClaw Inc., a Delaware corporation according to its privacy policy. It launched on Product Hunt on 20 May 2026, hunted by Chris Messina, and finished #1 for the day and the week and #2 for the month, with 784 upvotes and 272 comments.

We have not tested StoreClaw ourselves. This page brings together its official site, pricing, help centre and privacy policy, its Product Hunt launch and the official pages of comparable tools, and says where each fact comes from.

profile.platform: Web, with a mobile app and a Slack integration
profile.summary_short: AI agents that analyse your online stores and make approved changes to listings, SEO and ads
use_cases: Asking how sales are going across several stores at once
Running a store health check that flags weak titles or rising cart abandonment
Bulk-rewriting product titles, meta descriptions and alt text
Auditing ad spend and bids on marketplaces
Tracking whether ChatGPT, Perplexity and AI Overviews cite your products

paragraphs: Steven Zhou, one of the makers, wrote that the team had struggled to describe the product: words such as copilot, assistant or platform felt like an apology for what it does, and hunter Chris Messina's phrase, a collection of agents that know how to sell, fitted better.

He stressed that StoreClaw's proactive plans come with reasoning: the agent explains why it thinks a listing needs rewriting before asking for approval, so even a rejected plan tells you something new about your store.
launch_story.attribution: Steven Zhou, maker, on Product Hunt

fit: sell on several platforms, such as Shopify and Amazon, and want one place to ask about them
want an AI to suggest changes but keep approval over what goes live
want to start free before paying
not_fit: want a tool that only reads your data: write actions are the point, although they need approval
need published team pricing: team plans are quote-only
want to measure AI-search results precisely: a maker said that is still noisy

pricing.intro: Prices are from StoreClaw's pricing page, in US dollars, billed monthly. The page offers yearly billing with a 20% saving but does not show yearly prices.

plans.name: Free
plans.detail: 50 credits refreshed daily, one task at a time; no credit card

plans.name: Pro
plans.detail: 6,000 credits a month plus 100 daily, up to 10 tasks at once

plans.name: Max
plans.detail: 12,000 credits a month plus 100 daily, up to 10 tasks at once

plans.name: Ultra
plans.detail: 60,000 credits a month plus 100 daily, up to 10 tasks at once

plans.name: Team
plans.detail: Shared store profiles, role-based permissions and activity logs

notes: New accounts get 300 free credits; extra credits can be bought from billing settings. When credits run out, scheduled tasks pause until the next refresh.
You can cancel at any time and keep the plan until the end of the billing period. No refund policy is stated on the pricing page.

alternatives.intro: Two widely used options for sellers. Prices come from each product's own page, checked on 14 October 2026.

items.name: Shopify Sidekick
items.what: Shopify's built-in AI assistant for store set-up, copy, discounts, reports and admin tasks
items.starts_at: Included with Shopify plans (limits vary by plan)
items.difference: Works only inside Shopify, with no Amazon or eBay connection, but costs nothing extra if you already pay for Shopify.

items.name: Helium 10
items.what: Amazon seller toolkit for product research, keywords, listings, ads and analytics
items.difference: Deeper Amazon-specific data and tools, but you act on its output yourself rather than approving an agent's changes.

liked: Approval before any change goes live
Working directly in the store instead of copying output into Shopify
Connecting several sales platforms in one place
asked: How detailed the approval controls are (makers: changes in one session need one confirmation; low-impact work can run automatically)
How it handles new products with no sales history (makers: category baselines and public signals at first)
How it measures visibility in AI search over time
Whether bulk changes can be rolled back (makers: version history and monitoring)
criticised: Several technical questions were answered with a request to email support rather than in the thread

quotes.text: The approval-before-execution model is the right call for commerce. A rogue agent silently changing prices or running a discount would be a nightmare.
quotes.author: Bhuvika Mehta

quotes.text: Does StoreClaw have a learning period, or does it optimize from day one using a pre-trained baseline?
quotes.author: Jocky

quotes.text: A senior operator knows when not to optimize aggressively because of seasonality, inventory risk, brand positioning, etc.
quotes.author: Surabhi Minocha

pros: Free plan with daily credits and no card needed
Connects many platforms, including Shopify, Amazon, WooCommerce, eBay and Wix
Changes need your approval; connections are read-only by default
Privacy policy says your data is not used to train AI models
Low starting price for paid plans
cons: Credit-based usage makes monthly cost harder to predict
Yearly and team prices are not shown
Pricing page FAQ mentions a Starter plan that is not listed
Measuring AI-search impact is still imprecise, by the makers' own account

quotes.author: Bhuvika Mehta
quotes.text: Does it batch suggestions into one 'approve all,' or does each action (price change, inventory reorder, promo) get its own confirmation?
quotes.reply: Satomi said every change needs confirmation; changes made in one session are confirmed once, and separate sessions need separate confirmations.

quotes.author: Jocky
quotes.text: Curious how it handles a new SKU with zero sales history.
quotes.reply: Steven Zhou said it starts from category benchmarks and public signals such as search trends and competitor listings, then shifts to your own data.

x.none: We found no posts about StoreClaw on X yet.

faq.a: An AI platform for online sellers. It connects to your stores and channels, answers questions about your business and runs agents that suggest and, with your approval, make changes to listings, SEO, ads and more.
There is a free plan with 50 credits a day. Paid plans are Pro at $19.90, Max at $39.90 and Ultra at $199.90 a month; team plans are priced on request. New accounts get 300 credits.

faq.q: Which platforms does it connect to?
faq.a: The site and gallery show Shopify, Amazon, WooCommerce, eBay, Wix, TikTok Shop and social accounts, plus a Slack integration.

faq.q: Will it change my store without asking?
faq.a: Connections are read-only by default. The makers said modifications need your confirmation, and you can let low-impact work run automatically while pricing, stock and budget changes wait for review.

faq.q: Can it work with new products that have no sales history?
faq.a: The makers said it starts from category benchmarks and public signals such as search trends and competitor listings, then moves to your own numbers as data builds up.

faq.q: Does StoreClaw train AI on my data?
faq.a: Its privacy policy says it does not use your conversations, files or task instructions to train AI models, and that any future change would be opt-in.

faq.q: What are the alternatives to StoreClaw?
faq.a: Shopify Sidekick, which is included with Shopify plans, and Helium 10 for Amazon sellers.
